import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        String str = sc.next();
        StringBuilder ans = new StringBuilder();
        int taken = 0;

        for (int i = 0; i < str.length(); i++) {
            char c = str.charAt(i);
            if (c == 'a') {
                if (i + 1 < str.length() && str.charAt(i + 1) == 't' && ans.length() > 0 && taken == 0) {
                    taken = 1;
                    ans.append('@');
                    i++;
                    continue;
                }
            } else if (c == 'd') {
                if (i + 2 < str.length() && str.charAt(i + 1) == 'o' && str.charAt(i + 2) == 't' && ans.length() > 0) {
                    ans.append('.');
                    i += 2;
                    continue;
                }
            }
            ans.append(c);
        }

        System.out.println(ans.toString());
        sc.close();
    }
}
